32fdfe9b-6e11-4a13-9e36-dcd8ea77b4e4.title: Kanojo, Okarishimasu
32fdfe9b-6e11-4a13-9e36-dcd8ea77b4e4.description:
In today's Japan, "rental" services can deliver an afternoon with a "friend," a "parent," even a fake girlfriend! After a staggering betrayal by his girlfriend, hapless freshman Kazuya gets just desperate enough to give it a try. But he quickly discovers how complicated it can be to "rent" an emotional connection, and his new "girlfriend," who's trying to keep her side hustle secret, will panic when she finds out her real life and Kazuya's are intertwined in surprising ways! Family, school, and life all start to go wrong, too...

(Source: Kodansha Comics)

29ab6984-7c1d-4d45-b925-25aa082b492e.title: Shangri-La Frontier ~Kusoge Hunter, Kami-gee ni Idoman to su~
29ab6984-7c1d-4d45-b925-25aa082b492e.altTitle: Shangri-La Frontier: From Trash-Game Hunter to God-Tier Game Master!
29ab6984-7c1d-4d45-b925-25aa082b492e.description:
Second-year high school student Rakuro Hizutome loves nothing more than finding so-called "trash games" and beating the crap out of them. When he decides to change things up by playing a new, "god-tier" VR game known as Shangri-La Frontier (aka. SLF), he does what he does best: min-maxes, skips the prologue, and jumps straight into action! Rakuro may be a seasoned gamer, but a meeting with an old rival will change the fate of every SLF player forever.

Clad in nothing but shorts and a bird mask, Rakuro (player name: Sunraku) launches into the world of SLF. Things are going well at first as he takes down a goblin, a bunny, and even a python. But then Sunraku comes up against a huge, hard-hitting wolf known as Lycagon the Nightslayer. Will Sunraku's years of "trash game" experience be enough, or is he about to suffer a rude awakening just a few hours into his SLF adventure?

5fc26352-350e-4c09-9c58-f2c041cd430d.title: Boukensha Zettai Korosu Dungeon

5fc26352-350e-4c09-9c58-f2c041cd430d.description:
Dungeons. A romantic setting. However, that’s only for adventurers.

Cleaning, replenishing supplies, and dealing with complaints. Aine and Nacht work hard behind the scenes as floor staff in the dungeon. Damn adventurers.

The dungeon staff now turns its fangs on the adventurers who gather together while not caring about the troubles of others!

8116a628-d561-4528-9bff-76e667f43ba0.description: Hongyeon Kim has spent her afterlife generally being bored. So when a new program is introduced to entertain the dead, Hongyeon jumps at the chance to be transported into her favorite novel. However, when she finds herself in the body of the villainess, the demon princess Bella, she attempts a spell to speed up time to the end of the novel. Instead, she finds herself ten years in the past. Now, she must wait fifteen years to escape all while living with demons and raising the main character!

9774842c-6582-4727-9f4a-8b65587a1497.title: Cheopja ui Magyo Saenghwal
9774842c-6582-4727-9f4a-8b65587a1497.altTitle: A Spy's Survival in the Demonic Cult
9774842c-6582-4727-9f4a-8b65587a1497.description: Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

0495e9fc-9557-4f53-be80-79ce5feea7cf.title: The Tale of Samjang
0495e9fc-9557-4f53-be80-79ce5feea7cf.description:
Monk Sanzang from the "Journey to the west" has time slipped to the present-day Korea.   
  
She has lived her lifetime constantly fighting yokai but her most dangerous opponent turns out to be just one guy?!  
  
On the orders of Buddha, Monk Sanzang and her companions pilgramaged the Western regions in search of his teachings.  
Unlike Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing, who hoped to become gods in recognition of their contribution, rather than being tied down to the life of Buddhism, Sanzang wanted to remain in the human world and enjoy a new life as an ordinary human.  
  
But as she was being dragged to Heaven by orders from the Buddha, she notices a strange tunnel leading to the human world in which she escapes into…  
  
And the place where she fell is the Republic of Korea's Jeju Island!  
And she meets a guy named Lee Hyun?!  
  
The time-slipped Monk Sanzang a.k.a Hyeonjeong and the tsundere Lee Hyun's turbulent romance!

cf0a1779-0bd7-4b3b-9f67-558439acfa74.altTitle: Tanzaburo Tojima Wants to be a Masked Rider
cf0a1779-0bd7-4b3b-9f67-558439acfa74.description: Ever since he was born, Tanzaburo dreamed of becoming a Kamen Rider. Even as a 40 year old adult, he continued to dream about becoming one and he would train and exercise regularly. One day, "Shocker" appeared and attacked a convenience store to rob them. Springing to action, Tanzaburo put on a plastic Kamen Rider mask and faced the criminals. Instead of being seen as a hero, he was made into an internet laughing stock! Determined to end the fake Shocker's schemes by investigating, Tanzaburo takes to the streets as Kamen Rider!

8cd657d2-fa8c-4927-b884-44952fe5fbd1.title: Itoko no Ko
8cd657d2-fa8c-4927-b884-44952fe5fbd1.description:
His more-than-friends, less-than-lovers cousin is so cute that he could die!!!!? 

Nozomu is a boy staying at his uncle's house over summer vacation. In the countryside, where there are no convenience stores, or any busses even, the boy has a problem. That problem is his younger cousin, Sou! He's being led around by this tanned, energetic girl day after day and can't show her the dignity befitting his older age! On top of that, whether intentional or not, he’s getting flustered by Sou's inviting demeanor. Eventually, Nozomu couldn't take his eyes off Sou and is falling more and more under her spell...!!? With a "cousin" like this, his reason is having a hard time hanging on!

b38918b6-04ad-4d11-b978-6771c94c639b.description: A boy named Tooru has stopped going to school due to a certain incident, and continues to lament his current situation of simply living by inertia. One day, Tooru learns that his alma mater, Hanakaze Elementary School, is going to be closed. In a panic, he finds himself trespassing on the school grounds. Just when he thought there was no one there... he finds Hanako-san, the girl who used to play with him in the toilet!? Tooru is flustered by Hanako-san's aggressive approach. And there's more to this school than just Hanako-san...!?

b155dd4b-4db3-4dfd-80b9-d7690ee0c053.title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
b155dd4b-4db3-4dfd-80b9-d7690ee0c053.description: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Despite lacking friends or romantic experience, she started the Astronomy Association by herself, which is the only place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she dropped an association poster, but an upperclassman picked it up for her. The upperclassman introduced herself as Hayami, and Ayumu completely fell in love at first sight when Hayami recognized her passion! Ayumu's mind is now filled with love, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already adore something else. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!
